title: Inheritance and federal income tax - basics
facts: Receiving an inheritance is generally not itself included in the beneficiary's federal gross income merely because property was inherited.
Income produced by inherited property after inheritance, such as interest, dividends or rent, can be taxable.
Certain inherited items such as traditional retirement-account distributions or income in respect of a decedent can carry federal income-tax consequences.
State inheritance or estate taxes are separate and vary by state.
